verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Namecheap hosts DNS for domains. A first-party Terraform provider manages Namecheap domain DNS records one resource per record, and Namecheap offers Dynamic DNS updates against its own servers. Nothing covers the breadth of supported record types, minimum TTLs, or the management UI. missing for 10: list of supported record types, low/minimum TTL support, evidence about the DNS management UI's usability, statement that DNS hosting is included free with the domain, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, full DNS hosting comes with the domain — every record type, low TTLs, and a management UI that doesn't fight me

citations.quote: A Terraform Provider for Namecheap domain DNS configuration.
To manage records individually — one resource per record, so different owners can share a domain
